scope: Separate 12-case resident public-API profiles, not timing evidence. Parent-only strace (no -f); child executable work excluded. Memcheck sees native heap/access errors but does not fully account for Goose mmap-backed ownership/storage. Finite-only mode rebuilds a separate driver with only kinds0,1,4,5; it excludes cancellation/signal races. Callgrind instruction counts include byte validation and harness code, not just the library. No absence-of-bugs, peak-memory, throughput or equal-policy comparison claim. Published text replaces only the checkout prefix with <source>; original local logs retain raw hashes.
